cases.title: Uniform violation
cases.where: Crayellan Redwoods at Costique Bearcats, week 9
cases.text:
Ladislav Georridis (QB, Redwoods) wore non-approved gear on the field after being warned in the pregame check. He had been warned about the same item in practice. The league's equipment staff said the item posed a safety concern. It was his first equipment violation.

The league's uniform policy provides for fines on a sliding scale.
